test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 13 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: As per the Census of 2011, which of the following states/UT has literacy rate of more than 90%?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mizoram.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As per the Census of 2011, the state of **Mizoram** has a literacy rate of more than **91.3%.**
 
• Mizoram has a **male** literacy rate of **93.35%** and the **female** literacy rate of **89.27%**.
 
• According to the census of 2011, **Kerala** has the highest literacy rate of **94%** in India.
 
• The census confirms that the highest literacy rate among the Union territory is **Lakshadweep (91.85%).**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• For the purpose of census 2011, a person aged seven and above, who can both read and write with understanding in any language, is treated as **literate**.
 
• The 2011 census, indicated a 2001–2011 literacy growth of **9.2%.**
 
• According to the Census 2011, the literacy rate in the country is **74.04 per cent**, 82.14 for males and 65.46 for females.** **
 
• **Bihar** with a literacy rate of **63.82 per cent** ranks last in the country preceded by Arunachal Pradesh (66.95 per cent) and Rajasthan (67.06 per cent).
